notes.title: Tinertia VR update June 20th
notes.notes:
https://media.giphy.com/media/3ohzdIJMkBc5xa11lK/giphy.gif
On June 20th we will launch the Tinertia VR Update! With this update you'll be able to boot up Tinertia with your favorite VR headset & controller, and enjoy a truly immersive rocket jumping experience!

Both VR and non-VR players will share the same leaderboards. We've also added fixes for gauntlet level collision bugs and NEW leaderboards for select Gauntlet level seeds!

notes.title: Update Roadmap
notes.notes:
Fellow Tinertia Fans,

We've been working hard on upgrading your rocket jumping experience and here's what to expect in the Version 2.0.0 Update dropping this month:

 Tinertia has been massively upgraded: This means shiny new graphics, updated lighting, and better performance!

 Better Physics: The new Physics has some key improvements for example: wall-sliding is much smoother, and shooting off of floors & ceilings will now be very consistent. This will lead to some faster speed-runs :D

 We've tweaked some levels that spiked the difficulty curve in Worlds 2 & 3.

 We plan to reset the leaderboards to allow people to compete with the new improved physics.

 Our work on optimizing for consoles has made it to the PC version. This means better framerates with better graphics!

 Tinertia will now support higher resolutions like 2k & 4k.

 Major bug fixes for replays ( especially ARC boss ). Replays will now be very consistent with the playthrough.


The updates after Version 2.0.0 will contain new features: We'll be adding unlockable skins for getting time & par medals, and a new way to play Tinertia that's very immersive ;)

To tide you over here's a wallpaper created from a screenshot of Version 2.0.0, enjoy! Wallpaper 2560x1440px

notes.title: Version 1.0.7 Released
notes.notes:
New Stuff

New Options Menu with more settings.
You can now adjust stick deadzones.
Custom cursors! You can now select different cursor colors as well as some fan cursors.


Fixes

Improvements to Metropolis level camera ( on 06 and 09 ).
Improvements to Metropolis 08 flow.
Performance optimizations for Sewers & Mines.

notes.title: Version 1.0.4 now live
notes.notes:
This new build comes with changes to a few of our achievements.  Based on completition percentages we found the "Complete speed run without dying" style achievements weren't compelling users to complete them.  Here is the list of changes:

Exceedingly Efficient - Beat Command-02 without stunning any Drones.
Aim For The Bushes - Beat Guardian without using Air-Dash.
Days Without Injury - Beat Factory-02 without touching the ground.
Bootstraps - Beat Drone RamR0D without rocket jumping on it.
Royal Flush - Beat Sewers-07 under 7 seconds.
Set Lasers To Stun - Beat Mines-01 without touching the ground.
Baby Steps - Beat ReCyclops without shooting it.
To The Moon - Speed-Run any World under 5 minutes.

In addition to the achievement changes this build also features some art improvements and optimizations in various levels.

Let us know what you think of the changes in the forums, and happy exploding!

-Pherg

notes.title: Update 1.0.2
notes.notes:
http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/441700499321382686/B10FACB9C939496DE9794E846AFA3519284FA4C3/

This update adds a variety of UI enhancements:
 End of level gui now will show when players set new high scores on the leaderboard.  
 HUD now has par and time medals on display to show if the player has already obtained the medal on the current level.


Boss Rush mode now has cutscenes to allow a little breathing room between bosses.
